data.one_liner: Canvas-based Flutter lyrics with Apple Music-style motion, word highlighting, and LRC/QRC parsing.
data.what_it_does: A canvas-rendered lyric and karaoke widget that supports LRC, QRC, and YRC parsing, word-timed highlighting, translations, and customizable visual presets with animations. A single controller can manage multiple views.
use_when: You are building a music player or karaoke app in Flutter.
You need Apple Music-style animated lyrics with word highlighting and translations.
You want to sync multiple lyric views to a single audio playback controller.
avoid_when: You only need basic plain text display without any timestamp synchronization.
You are not building an audio or media playback application.
strengths: Canvas-based rendering for high performance with complex animations.
Supports multiple lyric formats including LRC, QRC, and YRC.
Rich built-in presets and transitions resembling Apple Music and other modern apps.
Shared controller supporting multiple independent views.
weaknesses: Requires manual integration with your audio player's position source.
Custom styling beyond provided presets requires learning the package's specific custom transition and builder APIs.
